classification: real pnpm registry production dependency audit

nonBlockingAdvisories.affectedFeature: Hono serve-static on Windows with an encoded backslash
nonBlockingAdvisories.exposureAssessment: the MCP Streamable HTTP server composes the package root request listener, but the advisory is limited to its serve-static export; repository and SDK runtime imports contain no serve-static import, and Console static files use the existing Express Management endpoint
nonBlockingAdvisories.majorOverrideDecision: not forced because the fixed major is outside the official MCP SDK ^1.19.9 range; retain as an explicit non-blocking watch item

retainedFirstFailure.cause: the restricted sandbox could not reach the pnpm audit registry and returned fetch failed
retainedFirstFailure.repair: reran the identical audit command with user-authorized network access

limitation: One Moderate advisory with an unreachable vulnerable serve-static subpath remains below the release-blocking High threshold and is documented in the final security report; this audit is a point-in-time registry result for the locked production dependency graph.
